<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Tardigrade](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=503)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 187

Tardigrades grow no larger than the width of a hair, but when their riverside environments are exposed to heightened levels of magic, these eight-legged omnivores can grow to tremendous sizes. 

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Giant Tardigrade](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3316) (Creature 9), [Tardigrade Swarm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3317) (Creature 12)
name: Tardigrade
